room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken. Optional add-on available to cap at 1% of SI/day up to ₹7,500 in exchange for a premium discount.

icu.note: ICU charges paid at actual; proportionate deduction for room rent does not apply to ICU.

copayment.note: Plan B: 10% co-pay on every admissible claim. Plan A: 20% co-pay only for non-network hospital treatment; waivable via 15% loading. Plan A has no co-pay for network claims.

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; PED 50% cap (Plan A yr2+)
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 10% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye, whichever lower. Plan A: PED claims from 2nd year capped at 50% of SI. Domiciliary (Plan B): 10% of SI. Road ambulance: ₹1,000/claim.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 12 months for both Plan A and Plan B. Under Plan A, PED claims from 2nd year onwards are subject to 50% of SI sub-limit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: List of 25 specific diseases/procedures (cataract, hernia, stones, joint replacement etc.) excluded for 12 months. Joint replacement has 36-month wait under Plan A and 24-month wait under Plan B.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI added per claim-free year; max 100% of base SI. Reduced by 10% in the year following a claim.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.display: 30 days (Plan B); 3% of hosp expenses (Plan A)
pre_hosp.note: Plan A: 3% of admissible hospitalisation expenses for combined pre & post. Plan B: 30 days pre-hospitalisation.

post_hosp.display: 60 days (Plan B); 3% of hosp expenses (Plan A)
post_hosp.note: Plan A: 3% of admissible hospitalisation expenses for combined pre & post. Plan B: 60 days post-hospitalisation.

day_care.note: 399 listed day-care procedures covered as per Annexure I.

domiciliary.display: Plan B only, up to 10% of SI
domiciliary.note: Not covered under Plan A. Plan B covers domiciliary treatment exceeding 3 days; several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension etc.).

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered for in-patient hospitalisation at recognised AYUSH hospitals.

organ_donor.note: No explicit mention of organ donor expense cover in the policy wording.

ambulance.note: Maximum ₹1,000 per claim irrespective of multiple transfers; payable only when in-patient or day-care claim is admitted.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, deep brain stimulation, stem cell therapy etc.) covered up to base sum insured.

consumables.note: Non-medical consumables listed in Annexure II are explicitly excluded. No consumables cover rider available.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment within India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage no look-back applied; claims not contestable except for fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days for all modes except monthly premium payment where it is 15 days.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability/migration.

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, infertility/IVF, overseas treatment, joint replacement (waiting period), external appliances, congenital external anomalies, terrorism acts covered

optional_riders.display: Room rent capping add-on (1% of SI/day, premium discount); co-pay waiver for non-network hospitals (15% loading)
